upgradePair.migrationPathFinding: The baseline and 6a8873db both record 0090_request_triage_assignee at 1788637394684 with hash a74c7240bdfda1ef490996e0295d81f23f6d81e53a2d79b6f4b814f6ed12af19. At 3fa407e3 that migration is renumbered 0092 (new hash), and 0090_onboarding_reviewed_types (1788630266749) plus 0091_account_issuer_retired (1788676706424) are inserted. The recorded a74c7240 row matches HOME_BRANCH_MIGRATIONS in packages/db/src/migration-journal.ts, so reconcileHomeBranch applies 0090_onboarding_reviewed_types directly and the normal migrator then applies 0091 onward. 0092 is idempotent (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, guarded constraint, CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS). packages/db/src/index.ts logs 'migrations: reconciled <tag>; continuing with pending migrations'. Covered by apps/api/src/request-assignment-migration.test.ts. The upgrade should therefore start without manual journal work; the walkthrough must confirm it.

confirmed: The bundled database user and name are openlaw/openlaw on postgres:16, so the pg_dump, pg_restore and PostgreSQL 16 link match.
The local file volume mounts at STORAGE_PATH, default /var/lib/openlaw/files, on both app and worker.
The Dockerfile has CMD and no ENTRYPOINT, so 'docker compose run --rm --no-deps app tar ...' runs tar without starting the API.
The image runs as the unprivileged node user and creates /var/lib/openlaw/files owned by node.
OPENLAW_SECRET_KEY encrypts the SMTP relay URL, signing credentials, SSO client secret and AI key; the rest of the database is not encrypted.
At boot, stored credentials that no configured key opens are logged and left as they are, so they stay recoverable with the correct key.
Two-factor secrets are handled by the better-auth twoFactor plugin under AUTH_SECRET, so a missing AUTH_SECRET breaks existing two-factor sign-in.
Signing connectors in Polling mode reconcile outstanding Envelopes from the worker, which is why the target must isolate the signing account before the worker runs.

SMTP_URL alone pins the mailer to the environment (source env); without SMTP_FROM the mailer is unconfigured. PUT /email-settings is refused while env pins SMTP.

The worker has no port or healthcheck in compose.yml; the doc engine is on an internal network with no published port.
AI analysis Settings still has Test connection; the API makes the test and model-list calls and the worker makes run calls, so the API probe can pass while the worker fails.
apps/api/src/index.ts now exits at boot if better-auth's schema check fails; the 'App keeps restarting' row already tells the operator to correct the first specific startup error.
